Storefront and customer routes of the health module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /health

Health check

Responses:

- `200`: Application is running. Body: unknown.

## GET /v1/health/identity

Runtime identity (env, and the database name in test mode)

Responses:

- `200`: Runtime identity. Body: unknown.
